chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amos jix ñi' bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu tanoolh gu Ussiias gu Jotam gu Akâs gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr jix kai tu' gu oidha'; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax jix maati' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu Israeel cham jix maati' gu ja'tkam cham juraa'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios daak jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx mo'o jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu vaas tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm mo'o cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu jiim; gio ba' cham tu' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu tai gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jugi na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p kiicham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu Sodoma tuutu'm gu Gomorra.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Sodoma jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu Gomorra.

Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu arto dhi' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu chuukug gu vaakax; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu vaakax tu' kakneer tu' gu ñi'ook ɨ'ɨɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu noobh na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu masad juanda' cham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juraa'n gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x dhi' jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh tu' gu ñi'ook gu vupui; na pai' dhuuk soi'm tu' cham tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix bhuup gu ɨ'ɨr gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' buimɨi vupui bhaan gu vupui; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Cha'pim cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ na ja'p jabook ka't; mi' dhɨr tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix duu na ja'p aajim na ja'p.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi jix bhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'tulhi'ñ boopoya' gu kuchii; na gu' gu chin gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ganai' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Llena juruuñ ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gu' jano'.
Jano' ba' jix toja jodai tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va jɨ'kchi bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'xkum; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan; mi' dhɨr cham ñi'ook na jir bhai' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' kuiñcha ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix kavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm na jix bhai' bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gɨ'kora' ja'tkam na ja'p maa'n; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' tɨɨt gu Kiudad bɨx bhai' gu Kiudad.
Jano' ba' gu Sioon bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx bhai'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'ua'tulhdhix ka't gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' boopoya' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' jajar na ja'p u'uu pai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix kavɨk ka't na ja'p dhi' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't bɨɨma'n cham.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuugalhdha' ka't tu jiim gu kavɨk gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios mo'o gu kakkavɨk ka't bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' aajim mui'x gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Sioon ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x gu ja'tkam; gio ba' u'uux u'u kavɨk; mi' dhɨr cham gu kuchii gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jakob na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas buusñi na ja'p gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' jix bhuup jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham namki' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu oidha' jix bhuup kavaayo; mi' dhɨr tu' namki' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix bhuup duiñxim gu ñi'ook gu noobh jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu' jix duñia'; na ba' cham uañi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai oo' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu vupui gu chio'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ ka't; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ɨlhdham bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bhaan bɨx; gio ba' ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan bɨx gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx gu Basaan.
Jano' ba' bhaan bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bhaan bɨx bhi'ñbak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx vaak jodai jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tarsis bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ ka't; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñxim.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk na ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ vaak jodai duiñxim jix toja jodai duiñxim jix uam jodai jix duu na ba' jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk jɨjɨkgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' na jix uam gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk na ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ daak; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jerusalem gu Judaa jix kavɨk bɨx gu takarui' bɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jir bɨx bhai' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' bhaan jix bhai'x bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk ja'tkam vaak gu taat tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu' ka' chulhiiñdha' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ka't gu novɨ dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bham; gio ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu vaak tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu Judaa tu'; na gu' nɨɨn buimɨi jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ja'p gu Sodoma uañi'ñ cham; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na gu' cham bhai' na ba'.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam; na gu' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x cham bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' bhaan buimɨi gu noobh ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨt na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhaan daraa gu ja'tkam bhaan chiñia'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' oidha' u'va gampai' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ba'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Sioon gu vupui; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bɨɨx tɨɨt.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Sioon gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨlhdham; gio ba' pai'; mi' dhɨr pai'; jano' ba' pai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Ekaraan gu novɨ gu chio'ñ kɨɨv gu u'vɨ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jugi chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' na ba' nɨidhat gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon ua'tulhi'ñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jerusalem ka't tɨɨgim jix bhaan; gio ba' bɨx gu Jerusalem tɨjɨɨ'ñ na jix do'ig.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Sioon gu ɨ'ɨr gu Jerusalem tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' gu kavɨk gu Sioon bhaan gu ñi'ook toov gu tukgam gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu tai; na gu' bhaan bɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ɨkgiga'n bhaan jix tónom gu tanoolh na ba' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dha' jix duñia' dha' oidha' u'va; gio ba' ga'ra' dha' oidha' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'.
Jano' ba' dua'ñ mia'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhi'ñbak gio; mi' dhɨr jup daam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu chio'ñ gu Judaa jano' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't duñia' oidha' u'va tu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu Koomo nɨɨrda' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' baabuk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' oidha' u'va; gio ba' oidha' bhai' ka't na ba'; mi' dhɨr mia'n ka't na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' cham ka't tu' jo'ii'; mi' dhɨr tɨbaa'ñ cham dhuuk bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jup daam ñi'ook na jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr bɨx bhai' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bɨɨx gu vaak gu maa'nkar bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu abitareeis tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook maatɨt baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ mumua'da' gu vaak jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va gu ñi'ook gu kai' vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh na ba' gu ñi'ook; na bɨɨx ka'm gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't baabuk na gu' cham jix duñia'; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' bhiogi' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x tukga'n cham gu ñi'ook gu chin; gio ba' jix dhaav gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu vupui.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ka't bɨɨx bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' ali' karneer ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ na ja'p bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan gu Israeel na ba'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu ñi'ook jix bhai' cham bhai'; na xoi'kam gu tasi' gu tukgam gu tasi'; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhai'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mamatdagɨm gu vupui mamatda' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk na ba' i'i suudai' u'va gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk na ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu Dan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' jix bhai'x jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p nɨɨn gu tai mɨmɨim ka't tatk na ja'p oo'; na gu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kuiñcha i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu novɨ tu' naaka'n; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx bɨx dhi' cham tu' jix duñia' i'iich va'k gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' gu oidha'; gio ba' ɨlhdham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kavaayo na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' jano' ba' bhaan gu oidha' gu tukgam chulhiiñ gu tɨkɨr gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu Ussiias tu' gu Jawatan daakat bhaan atooxkor jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu jiim mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' maa'n ga'ra'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gook gu ñi'ook gu vupui bɨɨx gook gu ñi'ook tɨɨt bɨɨx gook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak bham; gio ba' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu vaak kuubh.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jix koi; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ ñaanbi' gu ñi'ook jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam juraa'n gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix duñia' buupui gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' da'a bhaan tu' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'tulhdhidha' gu novɨ jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhaan gu chin; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan chɨtda; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨkka jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jiim tu' dhi' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' xoi'kam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' tɨɨda' gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam maatɨt gu vupui; na gu' cham bɨɨx gu vupui tu' bɨɨx maatɨt tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' ka't na ba'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu Jawatan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n tu' gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu oidha' ka't oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' baas jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook xoi'kam jix duñia'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu kai' abhaar.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu Akâs gu mar gu Jotam gu mar gu Ussiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Resiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu Peka gu mar gu Remaliias gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jerusalem na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu Epraim; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu u'u gu kavɨk kuiñcha gu jɨvɨl.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' jix buus jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâs tu' gu Sear-jasub gu mar gu Peskuera jiix gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu Labador.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix nukadham; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu' gu i'ii'ñ kuiñcha dhi' ja'tkam gook gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' i'iich gu ñi'ook gu Resiin gu Siro gu mar gu Remaliias.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu Siro bɨɨx gu Epraim bɨɨx gu mar gu Remaliias bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Judaa tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu mar gu Tabeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't.
Na gu' na gu' mo'o gu Siria gu Damasko mo'o gu Damasko gu Resiin; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim ka't jix bhai'x bɨɨx ka'm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' mo'o gu Epraim gu Samaria mo'o gu Samaria gu mar gu Remaliias; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tɨɨda' cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Akâs bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ba' tu' nɨi'ñchudat gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaam suudai' jiix jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Akâs; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu vaak gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gio gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan maa'n nɨi'ñchudat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Emmanuel.
Jano' ba' jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' va'k gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu oidha' tu' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gook gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai bhaan tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vaak gu taat gu tanoolh cham pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs dɨr gu tanoolh gu Epraim jix ai'chdhix gu Judaa maachim gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' aajim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oidha' jix gaki gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai bɨx.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan bɨɨx baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim maachim bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria mo'o tɨɨt; gio ba' gio.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gook kakneer.
Jano' ba' ka't kuiñcha gu ñi'ook bii'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi; gio ba' tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook jugi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook pai' ka't jix bhai'x jix toja jodai ka't na ba'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' bɨx gu oidha' ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx cham choo'n; gu' ka't na ba' gu vaakax na ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Diijome gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'ñxidha' gu chio'ñ gu Maer-salal-as-bas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Uriias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Sakariias gu mar gu Jeberekîas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu mar; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Maer-salal-as-bas.
Na gu' na gu' va'k gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat gu naan ka't gu kavɨk gu Damasko gu Samaria gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bham.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu Siloee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Resiin bɨɨx gu mar gu Remaliias.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu suudai' mumua'da' maachim gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan bɨx bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' bhɨi bɨɨx ka'm gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daam bɨɨx ka'm; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Emmanuel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam boopoya'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' boopoya'; jano' ba' boopoya'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu bhóogɨt dhi' gu ja'tkam bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Konjurakioon bɨx tu'x dhi' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Konjurakioon; gio ba' tu' ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't choo'n ka't ɨɨbhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu; gu' gook gu vaak gu Israeel gu jodai na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' jix duñia' jix vɨgɨ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' mui'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' ka't ui'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chuut ñi'ook na tu a'ga tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaichu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui gu vaak gu Jakob gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ma'nkam jix maa gu Jawatan Dios buimɨk gu Israeel baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'gi'ñchu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Apelaraa gu ñi'ook ko'iix koko'kam.
Na gu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga chuut tu' cham tu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' dhi' na gu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ua'tulhdhidha' bhiogi' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' chulhiiñ gu tukgam; gio ba' ka't gu tukgam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't dhi' gu tukgam jix duñia' na ja'p suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Sabuloon gu oidha' gu Neptalii; na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Galilea chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tukgam jix ñi' gu tasi'; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' ɨkgiga'n koi'm gu tasi' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam cham bhai' ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p oraa' na ja'p na pai' dhuuk.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tanoolh gu Madiaan.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx kutun gu ɨ'ɨr; gu' dhi' ka't na ba' gu tai.

Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook maaxir gu mar jix maa; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Admirable gu Konsejero gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk gu taat gu Priinkipe bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham jix duñia' gu oidha' bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' dɨr jano' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan bhañ gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨx gu Epraim gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Samaria bɨɨx gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ia'rɨ gu' tɨ'ya'; gio ba' chiiw gu' pai'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Resiin bhaan.
Jano' ba' tas buusñi gu Siros gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu chin gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' i'iich va'k gu novɨ.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel mo'o gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui mo'o; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Na gu' na gu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan cham biipibop tu' dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; na gu' bɨx iatgi'ñ bɨx gu chin tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx bɨx dhi' cham tu' jix duñia' i'iich va'k gu novɨ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu tai jo'ii'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p kuubh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oidha' ka't gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu tai; gio ba' gu chio'ñ cham jix duñia' xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu jiim bhiogi'; gio ba' o'nsop cham; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Manasees gu Epraim gu Manasees ba'k bhaan gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx bɨx dhi' tu' jix duñia' i'iich va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' bia' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh chɨkka jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk daraibu' duukat gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ ui'ka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx bɨx dhi' tu' jix duñia' i'iich va'k gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Assur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich; gio ba' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook daak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam daak na ba' jix duñia' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ dhi'; gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp cham.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chiñia' cham bɨx gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' cham gu Kalno na ja'p gu Karkêmis gu amat na ja'p gu Arpad gu Samaria na ja'p gu Damasko.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu novɨ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' duiñxim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samaria duiñxim cham gio gu Jerusalem duiñxim.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu Jerusalem bhaan gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu suudai' gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' na gu'; gio ba' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx matda'; na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam na ja'p jix kavɨk mi'p.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ na ja'p gu ñi'ook namkɨm gu ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' bɨx gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't gu chin.
Jano' ba' tas na jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨɨx jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan oidha' bhaan jiim na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' bɨtaa'n gɇ'kamtu'nda' na ja'p gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai jix bhaan mɨmɨim jix duñia' gu tanoolh jo'ii'.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' dɨr gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug; gio ba' ɨlhdham na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jakob cham pai' dhuuk bhaan naaka'n; gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx tu'r gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ua'tulhi'ñ na ja'p oo' gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chajaañ bɨx bhai'.
Na gu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Sioon cham jum i'obh gu Assur; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu Ejipto.
Gu' gu' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook i'iich na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Madiaan jodai kavɨk gu Oreb; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan jix duu gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Ajad gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Migroon; gio ba' gu Mikmas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Geba; mi' dhɨr gu Ramaa; jano' ba' gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Galim; gio ba' gu vupui bhaan gu Lais gampai' gu Anatot.
Jano' ba' gu Madmena gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Gebim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nob; gio ba' gu novɨ gu kavɨk mar u'vɨ gu Sioon gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix kavɨk jodai gu Liibano bɨɨx gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Saldraa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Isaii.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ matda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu kavɨk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ machia' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix maat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook bhaan ñiata gu vupui tu' maatɨt.
Gu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx bhai' bia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bɨɨx gu chin bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mar kaneer bɨɨx chiiw; gio ba' tuur maavɨt gu vaakax tɨtda:―Aañ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maavɨt na ja'p gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' bhaan jumpa'n gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu cham bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix bhaan gu kavɨk; na gu' gu oidha' ka't jix bhuup machia' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tatk gu Isaii gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam ka't chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' ka't gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Jano' ba' gu Asimismo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ na ba' gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Assur gu Ejipto gu Partia gu Etiopiia gu Persia gu Kaldea gu Amat gu Islas gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Judaa maakobh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨgak gu Epraim gu Judaa ka't; gio ba' gu Epraim cham jɨɨgak bhaan gu Judaa tu' gu Judaa gu Epraim.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos tas gei'ñ gio tas buusñi; gio ba' gu Edom gu Moab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios nɨɨn gu gɨ' suudai' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu novɨ bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bhaan gɨ' suudai' jiim kɨɨv bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Assur ka't na ba' gu Israeel gu tanoolh jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Diraas mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' i'iich jix ai'chdhix.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' cham; na gu' gu kavɨk gu Ja gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' tulhiiñdha' na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu suudai' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' buusñi tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ja'tkam buimɨi gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook tu'x; mi' dhɨr ka't dhi' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Sioon; na gu' jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia jix ñi' gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amos.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan jix bhai'x gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ na ba' kapbhai' kiki'ñgob chiñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk na ba' daak bɨɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' vaak jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk na ja'p jix jai' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' vaak jodai tɨroon oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jupaabkamu'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' kuugalhdha' gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios i'iich na ba' cham tu' duu bɨx gu oidha'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' mia'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ɨlhdham na ja'p gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu noobh bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' na ja'p gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim duiñchu'; gio ba' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oidha' u'ua'tulhdhix.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr cham; gio ba' gu tas gu masad cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' bhaan oipichu' bhaan jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix uam jodai gu chio'ñ jix uam jodai gu Opir gu chio'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' pai' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook i'iich.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kaneer cham bipia'dam bhaan gu ja'tkam maa'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' no'x ua'tulhi'ñ gaagam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' no'x.
Jano' ba' a'aalh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu vaak ka't gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu Medos cham jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'aalh cham jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu i'bhɨ vook tu' gu vupui uañi'ñka' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Kaldeos ka't na ja'p gu Sodoma gu Gomorra ia'lhxichulh gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' vaak zel gu Arabe tu' bipia'dam jix duñia'.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax gu vaak jix bhuup ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' jix ai gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh cham.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'; gio ba' gu vaak gu Israeel tu duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook aapi'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨpi'ñka' tu jiim choo'n juantu'n tu' jix duu tu juan.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ua'rgidhak bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia daipu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix utu'ñ kiicham jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx daak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu jiim chɨbɨɨp bɨɨx i'iich bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano bham; gio ba' dɨr tu' cham tu' jix duñia' bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' koko'kam namkia' jix duu jix búup a'toxkar bɨx chiñia' gu oidha' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak tu'; gio ba' tu' gio na ja'p no'ch na ja'p no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav tukga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu Lukero gu mar gu xibh gu Kortado gu oidha' tu' chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu tɨkɨr jix bhai'x ju'ñdharan gu si'avag gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk chuut.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbaa'ñ jix duñia' nɨidhim gu Altiisimo.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tukga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu' bham; gio ba' dhi' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Na jix dhaas oipichu' na ja'p oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh; na ui'ka' cham pai' dhuuk jix kupi'ook kuupa'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx nɨidhat maa'n gu vaak.
Gu' gu' tu' baas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tukga'n na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p tɨi'chu' koko'kam jix dhaav; gio ba' na ja'p gu chuukug jix koi.
Jano' ba' cham ka' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gu oidha' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr cham ka't na ba' bɨɨx tas gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat; gio ba' cham tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' tu' gu vupui oipichu' jɨ'dɨlh.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Babiloonia gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨɨx chajaañ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu jiim na ja'p gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asirio gu oidha' gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu novɨ bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ chɨkka.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu Akâs ka't dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham tu' jix duñia' tu' gu Pilistea bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu'; na gu' tatk gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' maa'nkam mar bia' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gu' tu' koi bhiogi' tatk kooda'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob; gio ba' duuñ gu ñi'ook kiicham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu' gu Pilistea; na gu' kuubh ɨlhdham cham maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moab; gio ba' gu Kierto gu tukaa' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ar-moab ka't jix duñia' duiñ; mi' dhɨr gu Kierto gu tukaa' ka't gu Kir-moab duiñ.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bayit gu Diboon gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix xuaak; gio ba' bhaan gu Nebo bhaan gu Medeba jix duñia' gu Moab; mi' dhɨr bɨx mo'o ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx jix dhaav gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu esboon gu Eleale gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Jaas gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu i'ii'ñ maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Soar na ja'p vaik; mi' dhɨr gu Luit jix tɨ'ɨ joi'ndam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oronaim.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Nimrim ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namkɨm bhi'ñbak.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Moab; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Eglaim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-elim tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Dimoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' tu' bhaan gu Dimoon gu Moab gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer gu oidha' dɨr gu jodai oidha' jix gaki gu kavɨk mar u'vɨ gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' ka't gu u'uvhig gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Moab gu Arnoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ɨkgiga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh na ja'p gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham kapbhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Moren bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Moab; gio ba'; na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Dabii jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab; gio ba' gu suudai'; gu' gu ñi'ook cham ka't jiimda'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Moab bɨx jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Kir-areset.

Na gu' na gu' vaak ja'tkam gu esboon jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sibma; gio ba' gu Jawatan chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Jaser oidha' jix gaki; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vaas gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx suanda' gu Jaser oidha' u'va gu Sibma; gio ba' tu' suakɨt gu ñi'ook gu esboon gu Eleale; na gu' bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan oraa'.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook yooxi'; gio ba' oidha' u'va cham gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k gu mar na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Moab jix bhai'x gu Kir-areset.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Moab jix bhai'x bhaan jano' ba' ɨlhdham xidhuu cham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Moab dɨr mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ka't gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Moab bɨɨx bɨx jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr ka't cham jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Damasko; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Damasko kiicham ka't gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu Aroer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Damasko; gio ba' gu Siria ka't na ja'p gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook oraa' kaipgaidhat; gio ba' ka't gio na ja'p jix duñia' kaipgaidhat gu ñi'ook gu Repaim.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'u gook vaik vaak na jix bhaan maakobh jixchamaam mamraga'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu akedor gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duu gu noobh tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tas.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jɨ'dɨlh gu kavɨk ka't na ja'p gu i'bhɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamraga'n jix bɨɨx duu tɨtda:―Cha'pim kuiñcha gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu kavɨk; na ba' gu ux na tu ibai' gu vaas gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix dhaas u'u jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' jix buusñi gu xibh; gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x gu ja'tkam jix duu tɨroon na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' vaak jodai gu ja'tkam gu jodai' na jix uam na ja'p vaak jodai mumua'da' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨroon gu suudai'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't na ja'p gu kakkavɨk vupui bhaan gu jɨvɨl na ja'p oo' vupui bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu xumai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' va'k gu xibh tu' cham; mi' dhɨr dhi' baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨkgiga'n bɨɨx bhaan gu Etiopiia.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu suudai' gu Andad jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ja'tkam dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n oipichu' gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk chɨgia'; na pai' dhuuk kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu vaak na jix bhai' na ja'p gu tas jix duu mi' dhɨr dhuuk na ja'p toov jix tónom gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na gu' va'k oraa' na pai' dhuuk gu i'bhɨ ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ua'tulhi'ñ gu i'bhɨ jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook mamraga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim bɨx gu u'uvhig gu kakkavɨk gu vaakax gu oidha'; gio ba' bhaan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'uvhig tu' bɨx gu vaakax gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr pai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu kavɨk gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gɨ' kavɨk bhaan toov gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr duiñxim gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gu Egipkios tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios bhaan gu Egipkios maa'n bhaan xibhɨk maa'n bhaan tɨtmo; gio ba' kiicham bhaan kiicham oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu Ejipto gu noobh gu Jawatan jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨx gɨ' suudai' jiim cham ka't.
Jano' ba' bhibhiadam gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duu bɨx gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' jix vɨgɨ bhaan gu suudai'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'sak ka't.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx a'sak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx xoi'kam na ba' gu vatop.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu Soaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamatda' gu Faraoon tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu mar mamatdagɨm tu' gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' duukat jano' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam mamatda' gu Diigante jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu Soaan jix duñia' chiñia' gu Nop; gio ba' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu Ejipto bɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't gu Egipkios na ja'p gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Judaa ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tɨ'ñcho bhaan.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu ñi'ook nɨɨn gu Kanaan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' ka't mɨmɨim kiicham gu eres.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat chuut gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu ñi'ook boosolh gɨ'kora' ja'tkam namkidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix duu gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu Asiria gu Asirios jɨjɨkgɨm gu Ejipto gu Egipkios gu Asiria; gio ba' gu Egipkios tu juan bɨɨx gu Asirios gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't vaik bɨɨx gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu Asiria; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix bhai' aa' bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto gu Asirio gu ñi'ook gu noobh tu' gu Israeel gu maa'nkar.
Na pai' dhuuk oi'ñga' suudai' u'va gu Tartaan gu Asdod na pai' dhuuk bhañ gu Sargoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Asdod jix bhɨɨ.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amos bham; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr jix duu jiim tɨbiaptuda jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix jiim tu duukam gu Isaiiyas tɨbiaptuda jix bhai'x vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu Ejipto bhaan gu Etiopiia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Ejipto gu Etiopiia kɨklhi'ñga'n na ba' xi'ɨraam gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Etiopiia nɨɨra gu Ejipto gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n dhi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't nɨɨra pai' na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ jupaabkamu'n pai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Persa; jano' ba' mia'n gu Medo; gio ba' bɨx.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr tɨiñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu'; gio ba' gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi i'i; gio ba' jix búup chiñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo gu ñi'ook jix ai; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan bhaan dhi' tu' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' jix duñia' bhaan jix nukadham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu chichio'ñ jupaabkamu'n kavaayo; gio ba' mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Babiloonia; jano' ba' bɨx duiñxim gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Duma; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak gu Seir; mi' dhɨr jix nukadham gu ñi'ook gu tukaa' gu Guarda gu ñi'ook gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham jix aa'; gio ba' gu xibh jupaabkamu'n mi' dhɨr gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Arabia; gio ba' gu kavɨk gui'x gu tukaa' gu Arabia gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dedanim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu Tema bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uux gu kuchii gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' oi'ñga' nɨidhim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Kedar ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix kavɨk gu ma'nkam gu Kedar ka't; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jano' bɨx tu' jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham jix bhai'x; gio ba' koko'kam cham koko'kam tu' koko'kam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' tɨtda:―Aañ jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx tu' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨma'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr cham chajaañ mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tanoolh gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' vaak jodai gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Elam jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ kavaayo; gio ba' gu Kîr jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu jix bhuup kavaayo ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bhaan gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Dabii gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu vaak na ba' vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak jodai bɨɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' cham jix duu tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jup tɨɨt dhi' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook mu'aa kakneer jugi gu chuukug i'i suudai' u'va bham; gio ba' gu xibh koi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatɨt baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na dhi' uañi'ñ cham ka't bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' ba'k dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sebna gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' chɨkka tu' tukga'n na ba' tu' na ja'p pai' jix bhai'x na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhaan jix bhai'x tɨɨda' tu' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu Te gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na ja'p gu oidha'; gio ba' koi no'm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ñi'ook xi'ɨraam gu vaak gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh mɨmɨim tu duukam gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx kapbhai' gu noobh tajaañ; gio ba' ka't gu taat gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu vaak gu Dabii bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook soo'mchulhdhak gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook soo'mchulhdhak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p pai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook nɨidhat gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx nɨidhat gu vaak gu taat gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x dɨr gu ñi'ook i'i bɨɨx ka'm bɨx.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ka't; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan jix dhaas; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Tiro; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tarsis na gu' bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaak tu' ba'k; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Kîttim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Sidoon bhɨi gu gɨ' suudai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨɨx mumua'da' gu suudai' gu Nilo gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' ka't gio chɨbɨɨp.
Ba' jix aa' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Sidoon na gu' gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk gu gɨ' suudai' bham; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' biipibop tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu Tiro.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Tarsis; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook mui'x gu tanoolh tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bhaan gu Tiro gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' chiñia' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' na ba' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Tarsis; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bhaan gu Kanaan tu' na jix kavɨk ka't.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sidoon; mi' dhɨr bamii' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Kîttim; jano' ba' cham jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Kaldeos; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam cham ka't; mi' dhɨr gu Assur na ba' oi'ñka' oidha' jix gaki; jano' ba' jix búup; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tarsis; na gu' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Tiro ka't jix duñia' na ja'p gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu Tiro na ja'p ganai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ñi'ook ganai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; na gu' gu vupui jix bhai' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' chɨ'ñchoka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Tiro; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ka't gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham tu' na gu' ka't na ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx ka'm ñiata nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' na ja'p tu duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix duñia' aapi'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p bi'iix; gio ba' jix duñia' jix maa na ja'p gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix maa na ja'p dhi'ñi.
Jano' ba' bɨx ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix duñia'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' oipichu'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; na gu' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kuiñcha mu'ai gu oidha' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' dhi' kuiñcha jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va bɨx jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham i'i suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu ñi'ook; na gu' bɨx gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' jiiñak bhaan suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx bhai' ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' kiicham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka't ki'ñgob.
Na gu' na gu' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p suudai' u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' jiiñak.
Jano' ba' tas na jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɨ' suudai' ka't jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' kuugalhdha' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Gloria jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Prebarikadores jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Terror gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't kuupka' jix duñia'; na gu' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' jix duñia' ka't gu oidha' ka't pai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x na ja'p; gio ba' bhaan uañi'ñ cham pai' dhuuk jix búup.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix bhai'x bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' cham tu'x jai'ch bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook ka't mi' dhɨr mui'x gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk gu masad gu ñi'ook gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu Jerusalem vupui bhaan daraa ua'tulhi'ñ tas na jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'p tu'r gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gɨ' kavɨk kiicham jix kavɨk; gio ba' cham ka't kiicham tu' cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' maa'n gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk tu' jix bhai'x kiicham chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gampai' gu kavɨk gu ja'tkam bhaan ɨkgiga'n bhaan jix tónom; na gu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix tónom pai' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p jix tónom bɨtaa'n toov jix duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu kavɨk bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu kavɨk bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam iiñat bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan bɨx gu vupui; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam bɨx gu oidha'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨda'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'.
Na gu' na gu' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' gu kavɨk gu Moab ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p muuk na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx tuttuidhix gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk vaak jodai; gio ba' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm oo'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' dhi' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix kavɨk kiicham tañia'; mi' dhɨr tulhiiñdha' jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob gu ja'tkam tu'r.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'; na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'; gio ba' kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm oo'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Rekto gu bhóogɨt jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gio gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' chɨ'ñchoka' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu oidha' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n oipichu' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix bhai'x cham bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu oidha' jix bhai'x tu' na cham jir bhai' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam jix duñia' gu novɨ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ; na gu' gio buimɨi no'ch bɨx gu ñi'ook buimɨi.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch mai' tu'; gu' tu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' koko'kam cham na jix do'ig; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; na gu' bɨx chɨ'ñchoka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tas na jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk soi'm na pai' dhuuk.
Na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa bɨɨx jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' tulhiiñdha' matgɨm gu oidha' tu' ia'rɨ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n oipichu'.
Jano' ba' koko'kam na jix do'ig; gio ba' ju'ñdharan bɨɨx gu chuukug jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n oo' na gu'; jano' ba' gu oidha' koko'kam.
Jano' ba' jiim gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' kiki'ñgob; gio ba' piidha' gu ñi'ook daak.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios pai' na ba' jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' bhaan; gio ba' gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr cham koko'kam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨɨx gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk bhaan gu ko'oi bhaan gu ko'oi; gio ba' mu'aa tɨrook gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va suudai' u'va jix vɨgɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu tukaa' gu tanoolh na gu' soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨkka bhaan tu' jo'ii' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu kavɨk gu aga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh aajim na pai' dhuuk gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu vupui oipichu' gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' na ja'p naaka'n tu' jix duñia' jix koi na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu jɨvɨl gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jakob; na pai' dhuuk ka't bɨx gu i'bhɨ uañi'ñ na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu jodai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ja'p gu jodai cham jix búup tu' gu tas.
Na gu' na gu' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim na ja'p oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' tuur gu ñi'ook mamraga'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk mamraga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' gu u'vɨ aajim jix duu; na gu' cham gu ja'tkam; na ba' gu akedor cham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu Ejipto gu ma'nkam gu Israeel boopoya' maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk aajim jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Asiria jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk jix bhaan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kuruun gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim gɇ'kamtu'nda' bhaan mo'o suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios juraa'n jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu suudai' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx tɨɨt ka't gu ñi'ook kuruun gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' bhaan mo'o na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p juraa'n gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuruun gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu kavɨk jix duu bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob.

Gu' gu' gio suulhgia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx suudai' u'va bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx jix bɨɨx duu bhaan suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' jix bhuup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm cham pai' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨkka jix duñia' mamtuxi'ñdha' bii'm.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan piidha'.
Na gu' na gu' nɨɨn gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨn tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' jɨɨpi'ñka'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨpi'ñka' jix bhai'x; jano' ba'; gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan piidha'; na ka't ui'ka'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tañia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx koi'm tu' bɨɨx; na pai' dhuuk cham no'ch gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Sioon gu jodai gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook u'uuk dhi'; na gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx koi'm bɨɨx tukga'n cham ka't gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk boopoya'.
Jano' ba' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu xibh gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' naak.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' iiñat na ba' jix duu.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix búup na ja'p gu kavɨk gu Perasim na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Gabaoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' duñia'.
Na gu' jano' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham gu ñi'ook; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu oidha' naak gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui cham tiriik kai' vaas nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' bɨɨx jix duñia' tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook; gu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia'; gu' cham bɨɨx tas jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gio dhi' jix buus gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook matda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ariel kiicham pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Añadid oi'ñga'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ariel ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't tu' na ja'p gu Ariel.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bhaan tu' bɨɨx bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook dɨr gu oidha' oo'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ja'p tu ñi'ook dɨr oo'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p oo' jix kavɨk na ja'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tɨroon bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mɨmɨim gu tai jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx chɨbɨɨp bhaan gu Ariel bɨx bhaan jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p juraa'n bhiogi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jugi; na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr na ja'p juraa'n gu ñi'ook i'i; na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' ka't bɨx chɨbɨɨp bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham suudai' u'va; jano' ba' cham.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu vupui; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook u'uan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' dhi'; mi' dhɨr; na gu' cham na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan cham tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' dhi'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' cham tu'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; na gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin bɨɨx gu ñi'ook nɨidhat gu' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' tu' choo'n na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook matda' mamatdagɨm mamatda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios buimɨi gu tukgam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka tu' chɨkka jix maati'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p bhi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jix duu; mi' dhɨr vaaso mii' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Liibano gu Karmelo ka't.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook u'uan gu vupui ñiññia tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bia' gu chichio'ñ jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook; na gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' ki'ñgob jir bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim gu Abraam tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jakob; gio ba' cham ka't jano' gu Jakob tu' gu vupui.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu noobh tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jix bhaan gu Jakob gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ vaak jodai mamtuxi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'; na ba' bɨɨx iiñat cham gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix dhaav gu Ejipto cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu chin; na ba' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu Faraoon nɨɨra ɨkgiga'n gu Ejipto.
Gu' gu' gu kavɨk gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xi'ɨraam ɨkgiga'n gu Ejipto gu jodai' na jix uam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk no'm chiñia' gu Soaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu anes.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k ka't na ba' xi'ɨraam na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' chulhiiñ pai' gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ maavɨt gu ko'oi da'a gu ux na tu ibai' bhaan namkɨm bhaan jix ai gu ja'tkam cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n u'ua'tɨdham; na ba' tu' jiiñak gu kavɨk dhi'.
Jano' ba' tu' jano' ua'ñxidha' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan u'uan na ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm kuugalhdha' gu tanoolh na ba' bɨɨx tas bɨx.
Na dhi' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam cham ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.
Na tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; jano' ba' cham jix duñia' ja'xñi tu'x tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't dhi' uañi'ñ na ja'p jix kupi'ook tu' na ja'p jix bhai'x vaak jodai jupaabkamu'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p vaaso cham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch xoi'kam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bapaalh cham bakia' na ba' gu tai na ba' gu suudai' oidha' suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨpi'ñka' boopoya' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chotdonɨt ka't gu kavɨk; jano' ba' cham.
Gu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo; na ba'; jano' ba' bhaan jix bhai'x; na ba' ka't jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n; gio ba' jixchamaam bɨx; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm na ja'p gu kavɨk na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhaan.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' na ba' mambhɨɨx jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ua'tulhdhidha' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk; na juraa'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'; jano' ba' tɨiñ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam maa'n gu Jawatan gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' bɨɨx bɨx cham pai' dhuuk tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' maatɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu novɨ gu ñi'ook tu' gu novɨ o'nsop.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai kutun jix uam jodai; gio ba' na ja'p; mi' dhɨr jix buus mai' daipu'.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' maa'n gu Jawatan dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia'; jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jugi kai'ñ na jix bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk bhaan bɨx gu kavɨk jix bhai'x bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu suudai' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu masad ka't na ja'p gu tasi' gu tas gu tasi' gu tas kɨɨv mui'kim jix gɨ' na ja'p gu tasi' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n; gio ba' gu vupui jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix bhuup daak nɨɨn na ja'p gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ bhi'ñbak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm baakux na ba' chɨbɨɨp bɨɨx gu ñi'ook chajaañ; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu tukaa' gakdhi'ñchix; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p tu' bɨɨx na ba' jix ai gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bɨɨx i'iich gu vupui mɨmɨim gu tai jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Assur naaka'n bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'x.
Na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨɨx na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' gu Topet tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tai gu u'u; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p bhi'ñbak choiñ jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto u'ua'tɨdham jix duñia' kavaayo; na gu' nɨɨra na gu' mui'x kavaayo na gu' jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook jix bhaan gu Israeel tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gio jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook cham bhai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhaan gu vaak bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkios gu chichio'ñ cham gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kavaayo gu chuukug cham gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi'; gio ba' na ja'p maavɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt bhaan tu' bhaan bipia'dam cham jix duñia' jiiñak tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix dhaav gu kavɨk gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu u'uvhig gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jerusalem jix duñia' bhɨi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ duiñxim jix toja jodai duiñxim jix uam jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu noobh ua'tulhdhix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Assur cham gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu kuchii cham gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu kuchii biipibop ka't bopxi'ñ.
