Jano' ba' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk chiñia' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu jɨvɨl na ja'p bhaan; gio ba' na ja'p gu suudai' gu oidha' na ja'p ɨkgiga'n gu jodai' na jix uam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu vupui maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' na ba' maachim nɨɨn jix bhai'x ka't na ba' ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham pai' dhuuk ka't tɨɨgim tu' ka't tu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' duñia' na ba' ñiokda' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki'; gio ba' na ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' ñiokda' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhaan gampai'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'x gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ux na tu ibai' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu oidha' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ jo'ii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan bɨx gu vaak kiicham bhai' ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't oidha' jix gaki kiicham; gio ba' gɨ' vaak na ba' bɨɨx tas pai' buur gu kakkavɨk xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm bhaan no'ch ka't vaak na jix bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix bhai'x oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix daa ñi'ook na jir bhai' oidha' jix gaki yooxi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix daa gu vaak na jix bhai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix daa jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' kiicham ka't bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx gu suudai' tɨɨt gu vaakax gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham pai' dhuuk; na pai' dhuuk xoi'kam soo'mchulhdhak bhaan tu' jix duu na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka' tu'; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix maat bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch no'ch tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu xibh tu' gio tulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp jix bɨɨx duu.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan na ja'p baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhuup gu Sioon ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook matda' gu kavɨk u'ua'tɨdham; gio ba' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't chumñigam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' cham tu' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Liibano gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Saroon na ja'p oidha' jix gaki; jano' ba' gu Basaan gu Karmel jix bɨɨx duu xiixkai.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jano' jix duñia' jano' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajar; gio ba' gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' na ja'p jo'ii' ka't bɨɨx gu tai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mia'n bɨxchu'x.
Jano' ba' u'ua'tulhdhix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon gu ñi'ook daam tɨɨtɨ'; gio ba' chɨkka no'ch gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tai jix duñia' chɨkka no'ch bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' tu ñi'ook jix duñia'; na bhaamki'ñ jix duñia' gu noobh cham naak cham gu ɨ'ɨr gu vupui cham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't pai'; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu takarui' gu suudai' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam nɨɨn cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon kiicham gu masad; gio ba' gu vupui gu Jerusalem gu vaak na jix bhai' vaak zel cham ka't tu' ka't dhi' tu' matgɨm ka't.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx no'ch jix kavɨk pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt cham jiim tu' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' u'ua'tɨda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' mui'x; jano' ba' mama'mkulhi'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gio ba' dhi' ka'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' oipichu' bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp tu' bhaan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' kapbhai'.
Jano' ba' koko'kam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr na ja'p u'uan; gio ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p gu suudai' jajar na ja'p gu suudai' iigɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii; gio ba' jix dhaav bhaan gu Edom ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhuup gu ɨ'ɨr gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr ali' karneer chiiw gu chuukug; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios juraa'n makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Bosra jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx aajim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutuur bɨɨx ali' vaakax; gio ba' gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr oo'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vatop oo' choiñ gu oidha' gu vatop.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tukaa' tu' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ kuubh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' gu ñi'ook soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhaan chajaañ.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt chiñia' cham oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx ka't cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jo'ii'; gio ba' ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' naadat na ba' gu u'uuv.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñchu'; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook na ba' jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n; gio ba' gio maa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan gu Jawatan Dios tu' oi'ñdha'; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu chin jix aa'ñdhix jum daa'ñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamai'chɨk gu novɨ bɨɨx; na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Liibano ka't gu Karmel gu Saroon; mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh kɨkbok.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n bɨɨx; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham u'ua'tɨda'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu vupui ñiññia ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatɨt jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios na ja'p gu ñi'ook nɨɨn jix bhai'x; na gu' gu suudai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki bhi'ñbak.
Jano' ba' pai' jix gaki ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' ba'bhak gu ñi'ook ka't pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt ka't tɨɨgim gu bhóogɨt gu Santidad; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr na ba' jix duñia' cham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt tu' gu vaakax jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook aajim gu Sioon bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bhaan ɨɨbhidham; mi' dhɨr bhai' ñi'ook ɨlhdha'.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhañ gu Rabsakes bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham dɨr gu Lakîs gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' jiix gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu Labador.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joa gu mar gu Asap.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chotdonɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham gu ñi'ook nɨnɨi'ñ no'ñ gu kavɨk na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jano' xoi'kam chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duñia' gu Ejipto bhaan tu' jix bhai'x ba'k gu novɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na ba' bɨɨx bɨx jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham mii' dhɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duu gu Esekîas jix aa' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' soi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Jawatan tu' gook jix bhai'x kavaayo tu' kavaayo bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' tu duukam gu Jawatan gu Ejipto gu chichio'ñ kavaayo.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jano' dhi' gu oidha' na ba' cham tu' duu cham gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu oidha' na ba' cham tu' duu.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu Sebna gu Joa gu Rabsakes; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook tu duukam nɨɨn na gu' no'ch; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch nɨɨn gu ja'tkam bhaan vaak jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' bhañ gu Jawatan tu' gu Jawatan tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook cham gu chichio'ñ bhaan vaak jodai na ba' jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨɨt gu Rabsakes gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook nɨɨn bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu Esekîas na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't kapbhai' dhi' kiicham gu noobh gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas; na gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'; jano' ba' maa'n oidha' u'va maa'n iigɨx gu suudai' oidha' suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ja'p gu oidha' kai'ñ suudai' u'va pai' gu takarui' pai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham iatgi'ñdha' gu Esekîas bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp maa'n gu oidha' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu amat gu Arpad duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu Separbaim jix duñia' gu Samaria gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios dhi' oi'ñga'n ka't gu oidha' gu novɨ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios namkidhat gu novɨ gu Jerusalem.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joa gu mar gu Asap tɨɨtɨs gu Esekîas jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas naak dhi' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix bhaan dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Eliakim gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amos.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu Esekîas tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh; na gu' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kai gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' soi'm tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs tu duukam gu Esekîas gu Isaiiyas.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham jum i'obh gu ñi'ook naak bɨɨx jix duñia' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix maat gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rabsakes gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Libna; na gu' tu' ka't naak ka't gu Lakîs.
Gu' gu' tɨiñ a'ga gu Tiraka gu gɨ'kora' gu Etiopiia; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Esekîas bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham tu' iatgi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem cham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bɨx oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gosaan jix duu gu Resep gu ma'nkam gu Edeen gu Telasar.
Jano' ba' duukat gu gɨ'kora' gu Amat gu gɨ'kora' gu Arpad gu gɨ'kora' kiicham gu Separbaim gu ena gu iba.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib tu' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tai; na gu' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ na ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amos bhañ a'ga gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; mi' dhɨr mo'o mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨkka bhaan chɨkka gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vupui jix bhai'x bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu duukam gu Jawatan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk gu Liibano; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham tu'x jai'ch; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Karmel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨɨx tɨɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu elo gu ñi'ook jix ai jano' ka't na ba' chajaañ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p yooxi' gu vaas na ja'p gu vaas va'k jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook ba'k i'iich bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' maatɨt; gio ba' daak gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat; gio ba' jugi dhi' oi'ñga' gook; mi' dhɨr oi'ñga' vaik gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va jugi gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Judaa bhɨɨya' tatk gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ jiix.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Sioon dodhia'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ dhi'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' cham dhi' kiicham tu'; mi' dhɨr cham ɨlhdham vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' ka't baas bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va cham dhi' kiicham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kiicham na ba' dodhia' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jix buus nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' naaka'n chamaam jix bhai'x jixchamaam jix bhai'x yooxi' gu Asirios; na pai' dhuuk jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh bɨx ka't gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Niinibe.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kua' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Nisrok gu Jawatan Dios gu Adremelek gu Sareser gu ma'nkam jiboi'ññor gu oidha' gu Ararat; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Esar-adoon gu mar.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas ka'ook na ba' koi; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amos; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu vaak na gu' tu' koi cham ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas gu vupui tu' soi'm gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' vupui bhaan tu' tu'r bɨɨx bɨx bhai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu vupui; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas bɨɨx suanda'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr soi'm naak buupui suakɨt; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' dhi' kiicham.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu' ka't nɨi'ñchudat baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook ɨkgiga'n tu' jix duñia' gu Akâs gu tas mambhɨɨx; gio ba' gu tas ka't mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook ka't tu' jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Eskritura gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'kdai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh tu jiim kiki'ñgob tukga'n; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ja gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu chio'ñ bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n oipichu'.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bhaan tu' na ja'p vaak zel bipia'dam; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ko'kdai'; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh; gio ba' na ja'p maavɨt bɨx o'oo; mi' dhɨr gu xibh gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p; gio ba' na ja'p gioda'; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x gu vupui; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu jiim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan bhaan na jix do'ig jix duñia' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; na gu' tu' jix duu gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' daam bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gu' tu' gu oidha' ja'bsuna'; na gu' bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tukga'n cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook koi'm; gio ba' tu' tu'r.
Na jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu taat jix duñia' tu'r gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' dodhia'; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jix do'ig gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Merodak-baladaan gu mar gu Baladaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas; na gu' ka't naak ka't dhi' ka'ook ka't.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Esekîas gu vaak chumñigam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨx gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' cham ka't gu vaak bɨx aapi' gu Esekîas cham.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ duukat jix duñia' tɨbiap tu' gu Esekîas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨbiap tu' gu Babiloonia.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' buupui gu vaak jix aa' gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak jix duñia' buupui matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch cham ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh ka't baabuk gu Babiloonia bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak tattat jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhɨɨ ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu Esekîas gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'r gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Konsolaos gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ja'xñi jiiñak gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na tu' dho'ñchidhak gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook duuñ oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu chuukug bɨɨma'n; na gu chin gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chɨtda; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ a'ga jiiñak bɨx gu chuukug gu vaas bɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu vaas jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'; na gu' gu jɨvɨl gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu vaas gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas; gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' pataasa' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kavɨk jix bhai'x gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh; jano' ba' tu' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jupaabkamu'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' na ja'p bipia'dam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ali' karneer baaso; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx vaik oo' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Kuieen gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam na ja'p; gio ba' na ja'p oo'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Liibano gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tai tu' bɨx gu vaakax na ba' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p cham tu' bɨx chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook cham tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhim gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam muuk jix uam jodai jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gampai' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu u'u cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tɨkkam jix bhai'x na jax chu'm jix duñia' cham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' naak cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu ñi'ook dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam cham jix duñia' dɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu oidha' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' muuk gu tɨkɨr na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p vaak zel na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu oidha' duñia' na ja'p.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' cham pai' dhuuk mai' gu ux na tu ibai' na ja'p tu' cham pai' dhuuk mai' ko'iim na ja'p tu' cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tatk gu oidha'; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na ja'p jajar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhim jix duñia' tu ñi'ook jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu vupui gu ñi'ook chɨkka dhi' tu'x; gio ba' jix buusñi jix duñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr bɨx mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ'; jano' ba' matgɨm; gio ba' jix duñia' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Jakob tu' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham naak gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' cham tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gɨ'x bhai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x jix mui' gu ñi'ook cham juraa'n.
Jano' ba' biipibop gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham jix duñia'; jano' ba' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' bɨɨma'n ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu chɨkka jix duñia' tas buusñi jir bhai' jup tɨɨt na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam do'ñcho vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' do'ñcho gu kuchii na ja'p oo' gu ñi'ook na ja'p jajar.
Jano' ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt pai' tɨɨt cham pai' dhuuk kia'mi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu chɨkka jix duñia' tu' dhi' gu Kuieen mɨmɨim gu ma'nkam dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n tu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chooto'n choo'n; gio ba' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mia'n; gio ba' xibhɨk jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bham jix bhai'; na gu' bɨɨx na gu' cham.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Israeel tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jakob tu' gu kai' gu Abraam.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' cham jum i'obh tu' jix duñia' bɨndak; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx tas tu' bɨɨx tas tu' bɨɨx kɨɨ'n bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhaan tu' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' ka't na ja'p cham tu' jix koi bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bakia' namki' gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨndak; gio ba' ka't na ja'p cham tu' na ja'p cham mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' xoi'kam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu jiim tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jum i'obh tu'.
Jano' ba' cham jum i'obh suulhgidha' gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Redentor jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix vɨɨk jix bhuup; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tas na jix gɨ' jix bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu suudai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook nɨɨn; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhi'spio'kai suudai' buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' oidha' jix gaki dhi' gu suudai' gu oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gɨ' u'u kavɨk; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɇɇkɇ' bɨx gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios duñia' dhi' jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix ai; gio ba' tu' dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gio tu' jix ai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' mi' dhɨr na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' na ba' bɨɨma'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham tu' buimɨi gu ñi'ook; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n ɨlhdham; gio ba' gu tas tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr chiñia' na ja'p bhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam na ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jir bhai' gu Kierto cham cham tu'x jai'ch cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' maa'n jix duñia' dhi' tu'x gu Sioon gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't; gio ba' tu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x ka't; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook buimɨi cham tu'; gio ba' gu jɨvɨl gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu duukam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ maa'n ñi'ook na jir bhai' chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' cham tu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu'r.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu oidha' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Kriador gu tɨkɨr muuk; na muuk gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na jix maa gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨɨgim bɨx bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ja'tkam gu tasi' chɨbɨɨp.
Na ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vupui ñiññia na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuupa' ui'ka' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu'x tumiiñku gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs tu' jix vɨɨk tu'x; gio ba' va'k gu tasi' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix vɨɨk bhai' ñi'ook dɨr gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na gu gɨ' suudai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jɨ'dɨlh taañpu' pai' jix daa gu Kedar; gio ba' tɨ'ya' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu jodai dɨr gu kakkavɨk jix maa jiiñak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia'; gio ba' bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' duiñ; gio ba' jiiñak na ja'p; mi' dhɨr bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaas; gio ba' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiññia gu bhóogɨt cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu tukgam gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x cham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook dhi'; gio ba' gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiññia gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka bai'ñchu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam chɨkka jix bhai'x na ja'p mattuda' jix duñia' chɨkka bai'ñchu' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bai'ñchu' na ja'p tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Na tu' mumua'da' tu'x cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatɨt cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch namkidhat; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Restituid.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' chɨkka jix kai.
Jano' ba' chɨkka jix maa gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam do'ñcho gu Israeel cham ka't gu Jawatan Dios bhaan cham jiim gu bhóogɨt tu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'aa bhaan i'iich daak gu kavɨk bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tai cham gu ñi'ook cham; mi' dhɨr gu' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Kriador gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu Pormador gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; na gu' cham jum i'obh na gu' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak; gio ba' cham tu'; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tai cham tu' gu ñi'ook tu' mɨmɨim tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Salbador; gio ba' gu Ejipto jix maa gu Etiopiia gu Seba tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ tu' gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' cham jum i'obh na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak; gio ba' tas buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas gei'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix maa jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr saagi'ñ; jano' ba' cham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ'; na ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu ja'tkam bai'ñchu' juraa'n gu vupui jix bhai'x namki' maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp jum daa'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch jix maa dhi' tu'x tumiiñku gu Presenten; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam tu'; na ba' tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr va'k tu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mai' tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k gu tanoolh tu' ka't; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu novɨ namkidhat; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' chɨkka dhi'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Redentor jix bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Babiloonia tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaav bɨx tu ñi'ook gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Kriador gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'.
Na jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu kavɨk; gio ba' bɨɨma'n na ba' cham jix búup; mi' dhɨr na ja'p dɨbaalhga'n.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x tu' chɨ'ñchoka' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' jootom gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax yooxi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'uuv; na gu' gu suudai' oidha' jix gaki na ba' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu'; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob; gio ba' va'k tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaakax maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' nɨidhat bɨɨx makgɨrxi'ñdha'; gio ba' cham tu' tu juan bɨɨx tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' tuumiñ tu' bɨɨx makgɨrxi'ñdha'; gio ba' va'k tu juan uañi'ñ jix bhai'x bɨɨx tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu'; gio ba' cham uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨma'n; gio ba' tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu taat jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' chiñia' xidhuu gu Jakob gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob tu duukam tu' gu Israeel tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu akedor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dɨr vook tu'; gio ba' cham jum i'obh tu duukam gu Jakob tu' gu Jesurun tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaas na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Redentor gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' maa'n tu' kuugalhdha' mai' tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' chɨkka tɨɨt na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' dɨr gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu Anuunkienles jupaabkamu'n jix ai.

Jano' ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham tu' dɨr jix bhai'x tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix kavɨk; gio ba' cham kakasnira'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' cham tu'; gio ba' na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu chɨkka gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' na ba' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu' gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook no'm ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' maa'n duñia' bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' juraa'n bhiogi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx duñia' gu chio'ñ na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ jix duñia' na ba' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ' u'u kavɨk jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; jano' ba' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tai; gio ba' bɨɨx baasɨ'n jugi gu chuukug jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook buupui gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' vupui bhaan bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' aagɨt; na gu' gu vupui na ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ na ba' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' baidhak cham juraa'n jix duñia' tu' na ba' a'ga; gio ba' baasɨ'n dhi' gu tai bhaan gu takarui' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu u'u no'ñ.
Jano' ba' maatai gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' cham namkidhat gu i'ii'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook gu Jakob tu' gu Israeel tu' tu duukam; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu duukam tu'; jano' ba' gu Israeel cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p toov na ja'p gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ; na gu' tu' na gu' tu'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr na gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu kakkavɨk bhai' ñi'ook; jano' ba' bɨx gu u'u; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim gu Jakob gu Israeel ka't tas na jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Redentor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr vook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tu'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨk jix duñia'; na mamatdagɨm matda'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam tu jiim; na tu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr ka'; jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa; gio ba' ka't.
Na tu ñi'ook jix dhaam suudai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Na tu ñi'ook gu Kiro; gio ba' bipia'dam tu jiim bɨx tu' gu ñi'ook bham gu Jerusalem ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; jano' ba' ka'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ tu jiim na ba' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan kookoxdha' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; na ba' bhi'spio'kai vupui bhaan kiki'ñgob cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kiki'ñgob jix vɨgɨ jodai jix kavɨk jodai bapaalh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu duukam gu Jakob gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' daam cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios mai' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu tu' cham.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tas dɨr pai' jix duñia' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tasi' gu tukgam bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham bhai'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr jiix tɨbaa'ñ bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu oidha' tulhiiñdha' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨma'n; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu akedor bɨɨx gu oidha' gu Diraa bhi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham juraa'n gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Israeel gu Pormador; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bhaan gu chio'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' bɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham cham u'uuk tu' juana' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu jiim gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Etiopiia gu Sabeos gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' ka't; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; jano' ba' tu' jix duu tu jiim tu' bham; gio ba' tɨɨda' tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch mai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't bɨx; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tulhiiñdha' baidhika'; gio ba' cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu oidha' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham jix duu jix duñia' na ba' jum duu; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu'.

Jano' ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam pai' gu oidha' gu tukgam; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gaagim; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chɨɨdaim bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr cham mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix duu gu Jawatan Dios cham dodhia'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' bɨx jix duñia'; gio ba' chɨkka jix duu dhi' dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam juraa'n tu ñi'ook dɨr jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai' gu Salbador; jano' ba' mai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin jix buus gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' cham ka't; na tu' jix duñia' bɨx tooton gu ñi'ook bɨx nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr aajim bɨx bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix gɨ' bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' o'lhia'n gu Bel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nebo; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu vaakax bhaan gu vaakax gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨma'n; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook chooto'n tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jakob bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel tu' dɨr vook dɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ka't nɨidhim.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai bɨɨx gu jodai' na jix uam na ba' duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan pai'; gio ba' cham oidha' bhaan jiim gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jiiñak tu ñi'ook tu' chulhiiñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' xoi'kam xi'ɨraam; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x dɨr; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' nɨidhim.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr bɨɨpɨ' dɨr jix bhai'x cham ka't gu ñi'ook; na; mi' dhɨr bɨx.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr tas buusñi gu u'uvhig gu oidha' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook jix ai; mi' dhɨr gio.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' cham jix duñia'; gio ba' tulhiiñdha' cham; mi' dhɨr tulhiiñdha' gu Sioon gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xanoop oo' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia xanoop gu oidha' cham atooxkor mar u'vɨ gu Kaldeos; na cham pai' dhuuk tu' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't xi'ɨraam ka't buupui; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Redentor gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Sieentate gu ñi'ook ba'k gu tukgam mar u'vɨ gu Kaldeos; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨɨt aapi' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar kapbhai' gu novɨ; gio ba' cham i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr bhaan jix bhai'x jix jai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia' aapi'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' mai' tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch; mi' dhɨr cham ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gook tu'x tu' aajim jix bhai'x gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx aajim bhaan tu' mui'x.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' bham; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak tu'; mi' dhɨr matda' tu' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' gu Yo cham.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham bhaan tu' cham bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' bhaan tu' cham; mi' dhɨr chajaañ cham ɨlhdham jix bhai'x bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu' dɨr; gio ba' tutkɨ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x; gio ba' jano' gu tɨkɨr gu si'avag jix maat masaa'n na ba' ɨlhdham bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p; gio ba' gu tai gu ñi'ook cham mɨmɨim; mi' dhɨr cham na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam bɨɨx tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr; gio ba' maa'n gu bhóogɨt cham tu'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu vaak gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel moor gu suudai' gu Judaa gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam chɨ'ñchoka' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu' cham tu'r tu' bɨx bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' abhaar kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' va'k tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chin jix buus; mi' dhɨr jootom suudai' u'va.
Na gu' na gu' kakasnira' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x jix kavɨk jodai jix bhai'x gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tanoolh tu'; na gu' va'k tu' na gu' cham tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duu dhi' gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' cham jano' tu' gu ñi'ook jix vɨɨk tu'x tu' cham.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu tanoolh; na gu' tu' va'k dhi' gu tanoolh naak na gu' cham; mi' dhɨr tu' bhai'x.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak tu' cham pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jix kupi'ook va'k naak; na gu' bhai'x tu' dɨr vook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich na ba' bhai' ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' na ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham na ja'p jix toja jodai; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' cham ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' nɨidhat cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob tu' gu Israeel tɨɨgim tu'; gio ba' tu' maa'n tu' gio kuugalhdha'.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu oidha' gu novɨ tu jiim gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx; gio ba' tu' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix duñia'; gio ba' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' tu'x gu Jawatan Dios aagak gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' dhi'; gio ba' dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam cham tu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr dɨr jix duu; jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Redentor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu' gu ñi'ook mai' jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨx bhai' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' mai' na ja'p oo' gu kai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k na ja'p; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tɨɨgɨ' mai' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kaldeos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm kuugalhdha' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi; jano' ba' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob tu duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk cham chooto'n gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu jodai; mi' dhɨr jodai kavɨk gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' cham cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' tomaat gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt dɨr vook; mi' dhɨr dɨr ba'k gu naan jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' chɨ'ñchoka'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu chin na ja'p gu kuchii juus jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx ɨkgiga'n gu novɨ; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel tu' tas na jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham gu kavɨk; gu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam na ba' gu Jakob; gio ba' xoi'kam gu Israeel cham bɨɨx bɨx jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu duukam na ba' jix búup bopxi'ñ gu Jakob na ba' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gio tu' gu tasi' chɨbɨɨp na ba' tulhiiñdha' bɨɨx ka'm kuugalhdha' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Redentor gu Israeel jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ chɨbɨɨp tu duukam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' chiñia' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix bhaan gu Israeel tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tanoolh tulhiiñdha' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba' jix búup gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook dɨppɨr.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ui'ka'; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu tukgam; jano' ba'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt ka't bɨx ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' bhiogi' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix tónom tu' gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' juraa'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu kakkavɨk ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam aajim; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ dhi' gu oidha' gu Sineos.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ja'tkam bia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar vook gu Aunkue tu' cham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook tu' no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx tas vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajim; gio ba' tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui xikoolh; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' tɨbiap tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx na ja'p kutun nɨidhat ka'; jano' ba' ka' na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki jano' ka't gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gio ba' ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam maatɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' tu' dhi' pai'; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' na ba' tu'.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' chɨkka jix mar dhi' ja'tkam na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; mi' dhɨr chɨkka jix duu suulhgia' gu Miren tu' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim; jano' ba' suulhgia' duukat mi'p.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ chɨbɨɨp gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ ka't.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bii'm; gio ba' gu vupui gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' oo' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨɨda' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jix duñia' ka't; mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' dodhia' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr ka't na ja'p bɨɨx; gio ba' jix maati' bɨx gu chuukug tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Salbador gu Redentor jix kavɨk gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu naan bɨɨx tu' chɨkka tu' jix duñia' gu Miren tu' na cham jir bhai' ka't gu naan.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soo'mchulhdhak; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ na ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' na ba' jix duñia' gu Miren bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai'; jano' ba' jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu vatop koi gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' buupui gu tukgam gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix maa nɨɨn mamatdagɨm na ba' maachim ñiokda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix duñia' gu xibh naak na ba' na ja'p mamatdagɨm.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook naak tu' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu vupui.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ja'p tu' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mia'n tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr chɨkka kuiñcha tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch gu Miren bɨx na ja'p gu ñi'ook kutun; mi' dhɨr kutun.
Jano' ba' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam jiim gu tukgam gu tasi' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Miren bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai mia'n; gio ba' gu tasi' gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ ɨlhdham dhi'; jano' ba' boopoya'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' gaagim gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai pai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a pai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu taat gu Saara gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki na ja'p u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bakia' tu' bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam; na gu' tu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ba' gu tasi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' mia'n bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook tu' tulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' jup daam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' nɨɨra.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na gu' gu tɨkɨr ka't na ja'p kuubh gu oidha' na ja'p gu ñi'ook kutun gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gu' tulhiiñdha' ka't na ba' bɨɨx tas bɨx bhai' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'p bɨx bhai' gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' gu chio'ñ tu'.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p kutun gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kutun suulhgidha'; gu' bɨx bhai' tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr cham tu' jix duñia' gu Raab naaka'n tɨrook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu suudai' jix gɨ' jix dhaam suudai'; na jix dhaam suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu bhóogɨt na ba'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Sioon ka't bhaan ɨɨbhidham; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' nuukdaidha'; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' choo'n gu chio'ñ koi'm gu mar gu chio'ñ ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu akedor gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu tanoolh i'iich na pai' dhuuk na ba' cham tu' duu; gu' duukat i'iich.
Jano' ba' kuupka' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' cham koi tu' jix duñia' gu takarui'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chin gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ɨkgiga'n gu novɨ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bamii' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios i'iich; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu novɨ bɨx gu ma'nkam jix duu.
Jano' ba' dhi' gook tu'x tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨkka tu' bhiogi' gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu vaakax gɨ' kavɨk jix vɨgɨ jix bhuup i'iich gu Jawatan Dios daak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi' cham suudai' u'va.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Miren gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu novɨ i'iich; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk i'i.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu chuukug na ja'p gu oidha' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem kiicham abhaar; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' gu ñi'ook tu' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' gu Sakuudete oo'; gio ba' bamii' xanoop gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook baakux jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu Sioon.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' cham tuumiñ boopoya'.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix dhaav gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Assur cham.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ja'tkam ka't baabuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' xoi'kam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' kuiñcha mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' tu' chɨɨdaim dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kakkavɨk tɨɨt jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix duñia' xoi'kam tulhiiñdha' tu ñi'ook gu Sioon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨma'n jiiñak gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨma'n gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan gu vupui bɨx chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' bɨx gu oidha' tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Miren tu duukam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' mui'x ka't gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu chin; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk ka't jix duñia' mɨɨjidha' naak.
Jano' ba' chɨkka tu' jɨɨ'ñdha' chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chɨkka tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan na ja'p tatk gu oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨ'ñ gu' cham na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu vupui ka't jix duñia' cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dudua'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ch jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Gu' dhi' jix ko'k tɨjɨɨ'ñ guch uañi'ñ, gio bhaan gu xijor na jix bhaan jum duu, aach jix bhai' jum duukam.
Jano' ba' bɨx no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kakneer jix ai'chdhix gu bhóogɨt; gu' gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñ bɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham jix kupi'ook gu chin; gio ba' na ja'p mar kaneer ka't baabuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr na ja'p kaneer vupui bhaan bhaan cham jix kupi'ook gu chin.

Jano' ba' kuupa' ñi'ook na jir bhai' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; na gu' gu ñi'ook chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu oidha' na jix do'ig; mi' dhɨr uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu' bɨɨx chutumñigam ka't koi'm; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duu tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' ka't iatda' gu chin.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ko'k duu; na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' uañi'ñ gu ma'nkam ii'mdagaram jix duñia' gu tanoolh aagak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhai'x; gio ba' bɨɨx machia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam jir bhai' mui'x gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' baasɨ'n bɨɨx jix kavɨk; na gu' ja'aa gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm koi'm ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx dhaibu baabuk uañi'ñ mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix maa jiiñak gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk juruuñ; na gu' gu ma'nkam tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Ensanka gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak zel ka't; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr dhi'.
Na gu' na gu' gu novɨ tu jiim gu novɨ o'nsop gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu kai' chɨbɨɨp jix daa jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' cham jum i'obh cham ka' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' cham tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr va'k tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x xi'ɨraam cham chɨ'ñchoka'.
Na gu' na gu' gu chio'ñ gu akedor; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' ka't tɨɨgim.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ tɨtda:―Cha'pim jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' tu' jix duñia'; gu' tu' bɨɨx i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu vupui tu'; gu' bɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch baidhika' jix duñia' tu' jix aa' gu Redentor gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' dhi' ka't na ja'p gu suudai' gu Noee; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu Noee gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham bhaan tu'.

Na gu' na gu' gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham jix duñia' tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix duñia' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios juraa'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'.
Jano' ba' gampai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx cham; gio ba' tu' gu jodai bhaan gu jodai' na jix tɨkɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai a'bhar kiki'ñgob gu jodai bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx bhai' ka' jix duñia'; na gu' dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham jum i'obh; na gu' choo'n na gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' ka't cham tu'; na bhaan tu' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu tai jix buusñi na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' cham tu' duu.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'tulhi'ñ bhaan tu' cham; gio ba' tu' bɨx nɨɨn bhaan tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu maa'nkar tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' tu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr cham namki' tuumiñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham tuumiñ cham u'uuk suudai' u'va bii'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tuumiñ cham gu takarui' tu jiim cham gu Oidme xoi'kam gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu Inklinad maatɨt gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' ii'mdagaram gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jiimda' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ñi'ookdham gu ja'tkam tɨkkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨmɨim gu ja'tkam cham chɨbɨɨp cham tu' jix maati' jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Israeel tu' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jɨ'xdha' gaagam mɨmɨim mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' ka't gu ñi'ook uañchuda'.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr dhuuk jabook cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jix maa gu kai' chutku' gu takarui' jugi.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhai'x va'k tu' gu ñi'ook ka't mii' dhɨr na ba' jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ boopoya'; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk vupui bhaan bɨx gu u'u yooxi' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't pai'; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' nɨi'ñchudat baidhika' cham pai' dhuuk ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai'; na gu' mia'n tulhiiñdha' na ba' jix ai bɨx bhai' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chio'ñ dhi' jix duñia' gu mar gu chio'ñ dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na jix nukadham juanda' jix nukadham gu novɨ duñia' bɨx cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu u'u jix gaki.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu tɨɨgɨ' tutkɨ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu duukam; gio ba' bɨx juanda' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak soi'm; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' ka't bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; na gu' gu vaak soi'm ka't mɨmɨim bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' bhaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨx gu vaakax gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiññia bɨx; gio ba' bɨx gagai' jix bhai'x cham jɨ'xdha' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr koox.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gagai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' bipia'dam cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu bhóogɨt maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu xibh na ja'p dhi' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' jix koi jir bhai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bɨx vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' chɨkka jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chɨkka gu chin nɨɨn cham gu ma'nkam gu kai'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx duiñxim bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu ma'nkam bɨtaa'n gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai baasɨ'n; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak na jix bhai'; jano' ba' cham no'ñ dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu kavɨk jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' bhaan ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx choi' tu' bɨɨx ka'm jix dhaam suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' gu' cham tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch; mi' dhɨr bakia' gu oidha' gu novɨ cham tu'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham tu' suudai' u'va cham tu' jix duñia' dɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' buimɨi cham tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk duuñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx gu jɨvɨl; gu' tu' gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Alto gu Sublime gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tas gu tɨɨgɨ' jix bhaan; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na ba' duaka' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na ba' gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' cham no'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' vupui bhaan tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' buupui gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix duñia' mia'n jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr.
Gu' gu' jix bhai'x na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jɨ'xdha' dhi' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' cham cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' duuñ gu ñi'ook baakux cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu ja'tkam uañi'ñ gu vaak gu Jakob uañi'ñ.
Na jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu ja'tkam bɨx bhai' cham tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' chɨɨdak gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Miren gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tanoolh gu chio'ñ gu i'ii'ñ mo'o na ja'p gu ñi'ook maatai gu Llamareeis dhi' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kookoxdha' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx.
Jano' ba' cham tu jiim gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; na pai' dhuuk tɨbiaptuda gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tasi' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' tulhiiñdha' kiicha' jootom; gio ba' tu' bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' duuñ; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia' ñiokda' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam gu tasi' gu tukgam ka't na ja'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tas gu i'ii'ñ o'oo; gio ba' ka' na ja'p gu suudai' cham pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka' tɨɨgim na ba' jix daa.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juanda' tɨɨt duñia' aagak gu tanoolh jix bhaan juanda' mɨmɨim jix bhaan tas na jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham duñia' gu bhóogɨt tu' aagak tu' a'gi'ñchu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bhaan gu oidha' tu' jugi gu maa'nkar gu Jakob gu taat; na gu' gu chin gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' naak na ba'.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook na ba' cham.
Na gu' na gu' gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' tu' tu'r; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim; na koi; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na ba' kutun tu' buimɨi ka't; gio ba' buimɨi gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chajaañ gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham jix maati' gu bhóogɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr no'x ua'tulhi'ñ cham jix maati' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duñia' no'ch ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham jix duñia' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu tasi' gu tukgam; mi' dhɨr gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ñiññia na ja'p cham gu vupui; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh na ja'p gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook na ja'p koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p bɨx no'ch gu ñi'ook na ja'p giokda'; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch; mi' dhɨr tulhiiñdha' jix duñia' no'ch.
Na gu' na gu' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' uañi'ñ jix duñia' bhaan no'ch; na gu' bɨɨx no'ch uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ñiokda' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' jix dhaas; na gu' tu'r gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ɨrban cham jix ai.
Jano' ba' tu'r ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix ai'chdhix cham bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' cham ka't gu chio'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai'.
Na gu' bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p bɨɨx tulhiiñdha' mo'o; gio ba' tɨi'chu' kutun jix bhaan dhaas na ja'p.
Jano' ba' na ja'p na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p na ba' daak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dɨr tas gei'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas gɇ'kamtu'nda'; na gu' ɨlhdham bhaamki'ñdha' na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu Redentor gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Jakob tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' dhi' ka't ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin cham gu chin tu' gu chin gu kai' tu' gu chin gu kai' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr jano' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; na tu' tɨbiap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios tu' maaxir bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tukgam gu ja'tkam; gu' bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' ka't ñiata gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' jiim chɨbɨɨp gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam aajim ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ ka't tu' gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk chɨbɨɨp ka't tɨbiap tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai tu' gu ñi'ook gu Madiaan gu Epa; gio ba' aajim bɨx gu Seba; mi' dhɨr jix uam jodai tu' kubhion bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
