Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu Kedar ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Nebayot tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr ka't bɨɨx bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tas na jix gɨ' gu vaak gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tɨbaa'ñ na ja'p giokda' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jup daam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tarsis dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam na ba' gu ma'nkam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Israeel tu' tas na jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' daak tu' gu' jix bhai' aagak tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob no'm gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa'; na ba' ka't tu' gu kavɨk chɨbɨɨp gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx ka't.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Liibano ɨlhdham tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨma'n na ba' pai' xidhuu; gio ba' tu' nɨidhat pai' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' aajim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu' tɨɨt bɨx tu' mɨmɨim jix duñia' gu Kiudad gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' pai' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bii'm chɨbɨɨp baaso gu gɨ'kora' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Salbador gu Redentor jix kavɨk gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix kavɨk jodai jix toja jodai gu u'u gu jodai' na jix uam pai' gu jodai jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ namki'ñdha' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook chajaañ tu' gu ñi'ook; gu' vaak jodai mɨmɨim gu Salud kiki'ñgob gu Alabansa.
Jano' ba' gu tas cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tasi' na ba' gu tanoolh tu' gu masad tu'; gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨɨjidha' gu tas tu' gu masad; na gu' tu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx ka't jir bhai' ja'tkam na ba' bɨɨx tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu noobh na ba' tas na jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix ali' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x jix ali' gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' ka't jootom.
Na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' na gu' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ui'ka' kuupa'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' jix bhai' aagak gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon na ba' jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' pai' maatai pai' bhai' ñi'ook pai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't mɨmɨim gu u'u bɨx bhai' gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup gu ñi'ook dharka' jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook mumua'da' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' no'm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer ka't uubas oidha' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook boopoya' mɨmɨim jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' boopoya' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jugi namkɨm chɨbɨɨp bɨɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda' boopoya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam dɨppɨr; gio ba' oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' dha' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan; na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu'r gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu kai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx jix maati' gu kai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jajannulhi'ñ tulhiiñdha' bɨx bhai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook xoi'kam.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p u'uu pai' gu ñi'ook gu kai' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' bhai' ñi'ook vupui bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Sioon cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jerusalem cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm na ja'p bɨx bhai' tulhiiñdha' na ja'p kañdhiir.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp bɨx bhai' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' jix vɨɨk gu chin gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' ka' kuruun gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨɨt gu Desamparada tu' gu oidha' gu Asolamiento; gu' gu ñi'ook ka' mɨmɨim gu epsiba gu oidha' gu Beula; na gu' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu' pai' ka't.
Na gu' na ja'p biapma' gu vaak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak gu ma'nkam; gio ba' na ja'p saabum bɨɨx tɨɨmo' bɨndak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhaan vaak jodai gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook nuuka'n; gio ba' bɨx gu tanoolh bɨx gu tukaa' cham jix duñia' mɨɨjidha'; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu Jerusalem bhai' ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk; na mɨɨjidha' tiriik jugi obhɨɨ'ñ tu' i'i suudai' u'va tu'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' i'i xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu jodai gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' ja'xñi mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; mi' dhɨr jupaabkamu'n gu Salbador; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mɨmɨim jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Redimidos gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' tɨɨt gu Kiudad gu Buskada cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu Edom gu Bosra bɨɨx jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' tɨi'chu' gu ñi'ook tu' chɨɨdaim bɨx bhai' jix gɨ' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam soo'mchulhdhak ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx daak bɨɨx i'iich; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr jajannulhi'ñ bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ oi'ñga' tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook daak.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx daak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam i'iich gu oidha' gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa bhaan gu vaak gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Ba' jix aa' na gu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Salbador.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix duñia' nobii'ñ gu vupui gu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam tu jiim jix búup bɨx gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix bhaan; gio ba' bhaamki'ñdha' bhaan.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tɨ'ñcho gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' duukat jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx bipia'dam kakneer duukat jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨ'n gu Moisees bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda'; na gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ' suudai' na ja'p kavaayo oidha' jix gaki cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' tas na jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr gu vaak na jix bhai' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' duukat gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook ba'k na ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat tu' xoi'kam gu Abraam tu' gu Israeel cham jix maati'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu taat; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñdha' gu Redentor gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ choo'n gu Bueelbete gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu duukam gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap na ja'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam cham pai' dhuuk tu' bhaan cham pai' dhuuk ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai duñia' gu suudai' na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' na pai' dhuuk duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham pai' dhuuk gu kakkavɨk vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' maatɨt tu' gu ñi'ook tu' buupui gu Jawatan Dios mai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bɨx bhai' tu' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' tu' na gu'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham tu'x jai'ch duduaka'.
Jano' ba' tu' xoi'kam bɨx no'ch gu'ch na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' na jir bhai' na ja'p; gio ba' bɨx no'ch na ja'p jajar gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' bhɨɨk na ja'p gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba'; gio ba' no'ch gu vupui gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim taata'n tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat; gio ba' no'ch tu'; na ba' tu duukam gu noobh bɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios daam tu' chɨ'ñchoka' tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' jano' gu ja'tkam gu'ch bɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jɨ'dɨlh oidha' jix gaki gu Sioon oidha' jix gaki gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu vaak chulhiiñdha' xidhuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' tattat ka't gu tai; gio ba' tu'x a'bhar jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi' tu'x daam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gaagam cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam cham gu tɨɨgɨ'; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu noobh bɨx gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim gu bhóogɨt cham jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' daak gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'm oidha' jix gaki namki' gu tukaa'; na kua'da' gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch tu'x.
Na tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' pai' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr suulhgia' kuubh i'iich gu tai bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'nak vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham va'k baaso.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tattat bɨɨma'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duu bhaan gu kakkavɨk bhaan; na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook baaso.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p tu' oi'ñdha' bakia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch; jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam cham bɨx.
Gu' gu' jix buusñi gu kai' gu Jakob gu Judaa bi'ya' gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu oidha' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Saroon na ba' ba'bhak kakneer gu ñi'ook gu Akôr na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu Portuna na ba' gu Destino.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; na gu' cham tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook cham; gu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu duukam jugi gui'x bhiogi'; mi' dhɨr tu duukam i'i gui'x gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu duukam jix duñia' boopoya' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu Miren tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ duuñ gu i'ii'ñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' mu'ai gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu'; gio ba' tu duukam tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu'r jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' duñiim gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'r gu ñi'ook; na gu' tumiiñku ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ka't gu vupui.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xixiibkam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; gio ba' maa'n cham chɨ'ñchoka' tu' ɨlhdham.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jerusalem bhai' ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook suanda' tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh tu' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh cham; na gu' gu ñi'ook koi gu ñi'ook ua'tulhdhix gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va jugi gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jugi; na gu' bhaan gu tanoolh gu u'u ka't gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam buimɨi gu noobh.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' mu'ai; na gu' gu kai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't va'k tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kua' a'gi'ñchu' tu' naak.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer ka't tɨtda:―Aañ maavɨt ma'n na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ko'oi oo' ka't jugi; mi' dhɨr cham tu' jix duu cham bhai' bɨx jix bhaan gu kavɨk jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' dhaibu' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr duukat gu vaak gu ñi'ook duukat dhi' pai' jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu novɨ bɨx dhi' tu'x bɨx dhi' tu'x jix bɨɨx duu tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gampai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Na gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaakax na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ; na gu vaak na jix bhai' kaneer na ja'p tu' gagai'; na ja'p tu' gu ɨ'ɨr; na ja'p tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; na gu' soo'mchulhdhak jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook cham; jano' ba' va'k jix duu cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu tɨɨgɨ' gui'p; mi' dhɨr tas na jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam kiicham gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' va'k gu mar.
Jano' ba' chɨkka jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhim chɨkka jix ñi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Sioon juruuñ gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix mar jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Jerusalem gu taat bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' bɨɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim gɇ'kamtu'nda' chɨbɨɨp na ja'p jix duu gu naan; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu ñi'ook boopoya' bhaan kɨkbok boopoya'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu naan tu' gu Jerusalem gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' chɨgia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ o'oo na ja'p gu vaas; gio ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tu duukam ka't bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham bɨɨx gu tai na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' daak i'iich mɨmɨim gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tai bɨɨx gu kuchii bɨx gu chuukug; gio ba' koko'kam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan kua'da' gu chuukug; gio ba' bɨɨma'n ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham na ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp ñiiñio'k; mi' dhɨr aajim gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ nɨi'ñchudat chɨbɨɨp gu Tarsis gu Pul gu Lud gu ñi'ook gu Tubal gu Jabaan cham tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios kavaayo jix ai jix bhaan gu kavɨk gu Jerusalem tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gio na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p gu tɨkɨr xixiibkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu' vupui bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kai' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juanda' ɨlhdham bɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ bhaan tu'; na gu' suulhgidha' cham pai' dhuuk koi tu' gu tai jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't bɨx gu chuukug.
